title: Joomla Extension - balbooa.com - Unauthenticated stored XSS in the "Recent Comments / Recent Reviews" widget in…
description: An unauthenticated stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the "Recent Comments / Recent Reviews" widget of the Joomla extension Gridbox versions prior to 2.20.5.0. This vulnerability allows attackers to inject malicious scripts that are stored and executed when users view the affected widget.
